market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC opened May at ~$77K, ran to $82.5K, then pulled back to $79-80K. Hitting $75K requires ~5-6% downside from current with 23 days left. Already came within $2K. Base rate for 5%+ pullback in 3 weeks is 35-50%. Market leans bullish but recent rejection at $82.5K leaves downside risk meaningful.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether $77K weekly open holds as support or breaks
